## [CN]API 一览
## [EN]API reference

| API | 说明 | 头文件 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `UIView.cyl_respondsOutsideSuperviewBounds` | 设为 YES 后，该子视图超出父视图的部分也能接收点击（默认 NO） | `CYLUtils/UIView+CYLHitTestOutsideBounds.h` |
| `-[UIView cyl_addScaleBounceAnimationWithCompletion:]` | 0.5 秒内放大到 1.5 倍、缩小到 0.8 倍、再恢复（UIView 关键帧，会设置 `transform`） | `CYLUtils/UIView+CYLUtils.h` |
| `CYLImageNamed(name)` | `imageNamed:`，系统缓存，适合频繁使用的小图标 | `CYLUtils/UIImage+CYLUtils.h` |
| `CYLBundleImagePath` / `CYLBundleImage` / `CYLBundleImageData` / `CYLBundleImageFromData` | 主 bundle 中某个 `.bundle` 内的图片：路径、图片（`imageWithContentsOfFile:`，不缓存）、数据、按文件名的 @2x / @3x 解码 | `CYLUtils/UIImage+CYLUtils.h` |
| `CYLImagePathInBundle` / `CYLImageInBundle` | 指定 NSBundle（如 `CYLResourceBundle()`、framework 的资源包）中的图片路径与图片 | `CYLUtils/UIImage+CYLUtils.h` |
| `-[UIView cyl_nearestControlBelowView:]` | 自身或最近的 `UIControl` 父视图，查找到 `stopView` 为止（不含）；用于找出 hitTest 命中的子视图所属的按钮 | `CYLUtils/UIView+CYLUtils.h` |
| `-[NSObject cyl_setWeakAssociatedObject:forKey:]` / `-cyl_weakAssociatedObjectForKey:` | 弱引用的关联对象：不持有对象，释放后返回 nil，用于指回持有者而不产生循环引用 | `CYLUtils/NSObject+CYLUtils.h` |

| API | What it does | Header |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `UIView.cyl_respondsOutsideSuperviewBounds` | YES: the part of this subview outside its superview gets touches too (default NO) | `CYLUtils/UIView+CYLHitTestOutsideBounds.h` |
| `-[UIView cyl_addScaleBounceAnimationWithCompletion:]` | Scale to 1.5, then 0.8, then back in 0.5 s (UIView keyframes; sets `transform`) | `CYLUtils/UIView+CYLUtils.h` |
| `CYLImageNamed(name)` | `imageNamed:`, cached by the system, for small icons used often | `CYLUtils/UIImage+CYLUtils.h` |
| `CYLBundleImagePath` / `CYLBundleImage` / `CYLBundleImageData` / `CYLBundleImageFromData` | An image in a `.bundle` of the main bundle: its path, the image (`imageWithContentsOfFile:`, not cached), its data, and the data decoded with the @2x / @3x scale of its name | `CYLUtils/UIImage+CYLUtils.h` |
| `CYLImagePathInBundle` / `CYLImageInBundle` | The path and image of a file in a given NSBundle (e.g. `CYLResourceBundle()` or a framework's resource bundle) | `CYLUtils/UIImage+CYLUtils.h` |
| `-[UIView cyl_nearestControlBelowView:]` | The receiver or its nearest `UIControl` superview, up to `stopView` (not included); finds the button a hit-tested subview belongs to | `CYLUtils/UIView+CYLUtils.h` |
| `-[NSObject cyl_setWeakAssociatedObject:forKey:]` / `-cyl_weakAssociatedObjectForKey:` | A weakly held associated object: not retained, nil once deallocated; points back to an owner without a retain cycle | `CYLUtils/NSObject+CYLUtils.h` |

## [CN]超出父视图响应点击
## [EN]Responding outside the superview

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| UIKit 在父视图边界处停止查找点击目标，因此超出父视图的子视图在边界之外收不到点击。移植自 issue 中的 `UIView (Chain)`（`ableRespose`），并做了以下改进：第一次设为 YES 时才交换 `-hitTest:withEvent:`（之前不影响任何 App）；继续对该子视图的子视图做 hitTest，而不是直接返回子视图；跳过隐藏、透明或不可交互的父视图。PlusButton 及其子视图由 TabBar 自己处理（#91、#202），本属性用于你自己的视图。 | UIKit stops looking for the touched view at the superview's bounds, so a subview that sticks out gets no touches outside them. Ported from the issue's `UIView (Chain)` (`ableRespose`), with these changes: `-hitTest:withEvent:` is exchanged only the first time the property is set to YES (no effect on apps before that); the subview's own subviews are hit-tested instead of returning the subview itself; hidden, transparent and non-interactive superviews are skipped. The tab bars handle the plus button and its subviews themselves (#91, #202); this is for your own views. |

```objc
self.raisedButton.cyl_respondsOutsideSuperviewBounds = YES;
[self.raisedButton cyl_addScaleBounceAnimationWithCompletion:nil];
```

```swift
raisedButton.cyl_respondsOutsideSuperviewBounds = true
raisedButton.cyl_addScaleBounceAnimation(completion: nil)
```

## [CN]图片加载
## [EN]Image loading

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 按 issue 的建议使用内联函数而不是宏，并且不限定图片存放的位置。`imageNamed:` 会缓存图片，适合频繁使用的小图标；`imageWithContentsOfFile:` 不缓存，适合较大或不常用的图片，降低内存占用。没有扩展名的文件名会自动补 ".png"。使用 `use_frameworks!` 时，库的资源包位于 framework 内而不在主 bundle 中，此时请用 `CYLImageInBundle` 并传入对应的 NSBundle。 | As the issue suggests, these are inline functions, not macros, and the images can live anywhere. `imageNamed:` caches, which suits small icons used often; `imageWithContentsOfFile:` does not, which saves memory for large or rarely used images. ".png" is added to a file name without an extension. With `use_frameworks!` a library's resource bundle is inside its framework, not in the main bundle; use `CYLImageInBundle` with that NSBundle then. |

```objc
// TabBarIcons.bundle/home/home_normal.png in the app. App 中的 TabBarIcons.bundle/home/home_normal.png。
UIImage *home = CYLBundleImage(nil, @"TabBarIcons", @"home", @"home_normal");
// A file in a given bundle. 指定 bundle 中的文件。
UIImage *sample = CYLImageInBundle(CYLResourceBundle(), nil, @"cyl_badge_sample_icon@3x.png");
```

## [CN]演示
## [EN]Demo

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| ObjC Demo（`Example`）列表顶部的设置分组：「超出父视图响应点击（issue #535）」行中，按钮的右半部分位于灰色方框之外，开关关闭时点击它没有反应，打开后有反应，每次点击都会播放 `-cyl_addScaleBounceAnimationWithCompletion:` 并计数；「从 bundle 加载图片（issue #535）」行的图标由 `CYLImageInBundle` 从本库资源包读取，文字说明 `CYLBundleImage` 能否在主 bundle 中找到它。 | In the settings section of the ObjC demo (`Example`): in the "Respond outside the superview (issue #535)" row, the right half of the button is outside a gray box; with the switch off a tap there does nothing, with it on it responds, and each tap plays `-cyl_addScaleBounceAnimationWithCompletion:` and counts. The icon of the "Load images from a bundle (issue #535)" row is read from this library's resource bundle with `CYLImageInBundle`, and the text says whether `CYLBundleImage` finds it in the main bundle. |

## [CN]兼容性
## [EN]Compatibility

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 支持 iOS 12 及以上，只使用 UIKit 与 Objective-C runtime，不依赖 Lottie、FlatDesign 或 TabBar 代码。 | iOS 12 and later. Only UIKit and the Objective-C runtime are used; no Lottie, FlatDesign or tab bar code. |
